resources.string: This feature engine is not connected yet
No sample jobs, progress, or results are displayed as real activity. This page does not execute operations or change your data.
Forwarder delivery, caption rules, albums, duplicate prevention, and recovery do not yet have a complete Android executor.
Automation rules cannot yet run through a persistent Android scheduler. No sample rules are treated as active.
Sync and mirroring are not connected to an Android executor yet. This page does not scan or change phone or Telegram folders.
Desktop transfer profiles cannot yet be fully saved and applied to Android executors. Sample presets are not treated as applied configuration.
Forwarder, automation, Studio, and sync jobs do not yet have complete Android executors. Old transfer records are not treated as executable jobs.
Cloud downloads have a separate native queue. Open it to inspect actual bytes and control download jobs for this account.
Select a verified account to open its cloud download queue.
Backup and restore are not available yet: consistent snapshots, integrity validation, and atomic commit are not connected. Your database, WAL, and sessions will not be changed.
This turbo option is not connected to Android executor network policy yet. Old preferences are retained, but are not displayed as an active engine setting.
